commands.command: set -e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "613c6d427b4b753aab3c5aa05d73815f4fadb01e"; SERIAL=192.168.0.100:34771; trap 'adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent KEYCODE_ENDCALL >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo pre_call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.CALL -d tel:510100100 >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 30); do STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo call_state=$STATE; if [ "$STATE" = "2" ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; test "$STATE" = "2"; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; set +e; OUTPUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe inject-tone 400 1000 0.05" 2>&1); RC=$?; set -e; echo "$OUTPUT"; echo inject_exit=$RC; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent KEYCODE_ENDCALL >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; POST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo post_call_state=$POST; trap - EXIT; test "$POST" = "0"; echo livecall_tone_probe_complete=true
